newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot studies new Renault prices.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot studies new Renault prices.

text.p: Automobiles Peugeot, the biggest car division of the PSA Peugeot Citroen group, is studying price cuts announced by rival Renault SA as part of a new marketing policy, a Peugeot spokesman said on Wednesday.
"It's certain we'll have to confront this new marketing strategy. We'll have to adapt," he told Reuters.

A spokeswoman at Automobiles Citroen said the group would not react to Renault. "We're waiting to see what the government will decide about (extending) the rebate scheme and see how the market bears up," she said. A year-long state new-cars-for-old incentive scheme expires on September 30.

Renault said it would cut car prices in France by up to five percent on some models from October 1 to recapture lost market share. It said it would simplify its price range, lower prices for some cars and offer more options without charging extra on others.
